anchor_verdict.inconclusive: no cell is unstable and at least one required cell is inconclusive
anchor_verdict.needs_work: all cells are resolved and at least one semantic cell is confirmed no or unclear, or deterministic lint fails
anchor_verdict.testable: deterministic lint passes and every semantic cell is confirmed yes
anchor_verdict.unstable: at least one required cell is unstable

per_cell.first_two_same_and_both_confident: confirmed(answer); yes is positive, no or unclear is a confirmed negative
per_cell.first_two_same_but_either_low: inconclusive; do not make a third call
